title: 第一卷 第15章 秦家之秘第一卷 第16章 丹玄三重
lines: 秦家长老轰然响应。
秦家人不惹事，可也不怕事。
柳家既然还不了彩礼，那就要他们家族的其他东西来偿还。
既然柳家祖坟中有好东西，用这些来还自然合情合理。
“奉少族长之命，挖了柳家的坟，直到凑齐彩礼为止！”
一众长老齐齐大喊，随后便立即行动。
趁着在场众人不在意的功夫，秦玄偷偷将地上杨老的尸体丢进了乾坤戒中。
随后他便和一众长老朝着柳家祖坟那边赶了过去。
柳家人想要阻止，可是看着气势汹汹的秦家人，无人敢动。
柳生屈辱地攥紧拳头，他很想站出来怒斥秦玄。
可他确实拿不出那么多的灵石来赔偿，只能眼睁睁地看着秦家人朝着柳家祖坟赶了过去。
柳家的祖坟就在柳家的后山旁，当年柳家发达的时候曾经在祖坟四周布置了几个防御极强的阵法。
而此时，柳家祖坟的防御阵法已经启动。
“什么人，竟然敢擅闯柳家祖墓！”
接负责看守从冲了出来。
“聒噪！”
领头的秦家长老狠狠的就是一巴掌，将这几个人全都拍在了地上。
“从现在开始，这里被我们秦家给接管了！”
几个秦家长老看向前方的防御阵法。
“这乌龟壳倒是有点意思，不过算不得什么！”
这几个秦家长老看了一眼，随即便开始对这防御阵法动手。
柳家祖墓的防御阵法确实不错，可是这么多年下来，阵法的威力早就变弱，因此面对这么多的玄境强者的进攻，没过多久就被攻破。
阵法破灭，整个祖墓的样子彻底暴露在了秦玄面前。
秦玄的视线从祖墓里的各个坟茔上扫过，他的视线定格在了整个祖墓最中央最大的一座坟茔上。
这是开创柳家的第一代家主的坟茔。
第一代柳家家主可是玉清境强者，这坟茔里珍贵的可不仅是这些陪葬品，就连他的尸骸都在里面。
“挖了这座坟想来就够了！”
秦玄一声令下，秦家人立即动手，没过多久，封土被扫开，地宫也被打开。
感受着地宫中充盈的灵气，秦玄满意的点了点头。
果然，这里有好东西！
想到这里，秦玄挥手，立即下令所有人冲了进去。
“把里面的东西都拿出来！”
content_en:
"Yes!"
The elders of the Qin family responded loudly.
The Qin family does not cause trouble, but they are not afraid of it either.
Since the Liu family could not repay the bride price, they would have to repay it with other things from their family.
Since there are good things in the Liu family's ancestral tombs, it is natural and reasonable to use these to repay them.
"On the order of the young clan leader, I dug the Liu family's grave until I could collect the betrothal gift!"
All the elders shouted in unison, and then took action immediately.
While everyone present was not paying attention, Qin Xuan secretly threw Mr. Yang's body on the ground into the Qiankun Ring.
Then he and a group of elders rushed towards the Liu family's ancestral grave.
The Liu family wanted to stop them, but looking at the aggressive Qin family, no one dared to move.
Liu Sheng clenched his fists in humiliation. He wanted to stand up and angrily scold Qin Xuan.
But he really couldn't afford that many spiritual stones to compensate, so he could only watch helplessly as the Qin family rushed towards the Liu family's ancestral grave.
The Liu family's ancestral tomb is located next to the mountain behind the Liu family. When the Liu family was prosperous, several extremely defensive formations were deployed around the ancestral tomb.
At this time, the defensive formation of the Liu family's ancestral tomb has been activated.
"Who dares to break into the Liu family's ancestral tomb!"
The guard in charge rushed out.
"Crack!"
"Noisy!"
The leader of the Qin family slapped all these people to the ground with a fierce slap.
"From now on, this place is taken over by our Qin family!"
Several elders of the Qin family looked at the defensive formation ahead.
"This turtle shell is interesting, but it's nothing!"
The Qin family elders took one look at it and then started to take action on the defensive formation.
The defensive formation of the Liu family's ancestral tomb is indeed good, but after so many years, the power of the formation has long been weakened. Therefore, faced with the attacks of so many powerful people in the Xuan Realm, it was not long before it was breached.
The formation was shattered, and the entire ancestral tomb was completely exposed to Qin Xuan.
Qin Xuan's eyes swept across the tombs in the ancestral tomb, and his eyes were fixed on the largest tomb in the center of the entire ancestral tomb.
This is the tomb of the first generation head of the Liu family who founded the Liu family.
The first generation head of the Liu family was a strong man in the Yuqing realm. What is precious in this tomb are not only the burial objects, but also his corpse.
"It's enough to dig this grave!"
Qin Xuan gave the order, and the Qin family immediately took action. Not long after, the seal was swept away and the underground palace was opened.
Feeling the full spiritual energy in the underground palace, Qin Xuan nodded with satisfaction.
Sure enough, there is good stuff here!
Thinking of this, Qin Xuan waved his hand and immediately ordered everyone to rush in.
"Take everything out!"
